title: Roast Vegetable and Feta Salad
subtitle: Oven-roasted Mediterranean vegetables with crumbled feta and fresh herbs
excerpt: Roasted aubergine, courgette and red peppers with crumbled feta and fresh herbs, served on rocket. A salad that can go warm to the table or be made ahead and served at room temperature.
sourceNotes: Roasted vegetable salads with feta are embedded in modern British Mediterranean-influenced cooking, associated particularly with the wave of recipe writing inspired by Greek, Turkish and Italian traditions that emerged in Britain in the 1990s. The combination of roasted vegetables with fresh feta cheese reflects Eastern Mediterranean mezze traditions adapted for the British supper table.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Roast the vegetables up to 4 hours ahead. Add feta and herbs just before serving.

content.text: Roast vegetable and feta salad needs good roasting: vegetables with colour and caramelisation at the edges, not just softened. The feta should be crumbled and scattered cold over the warm vegetables, where it softens slightly without melting. Rocket or spinach underneath gives structure to the salad; without a leaf base it reads more as a side dish.

items.prepNote: deseeded and cut into large pieces

content.text: Heat the oven to 200 C. Spread the aubergine, courgette and red peppers across one or two baking trays so they sit in a single layer. Drizzle with 4 tablespoons of olive oil and sprinkle with salt. Toss to coat. Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, turning once, until the vegetables are tender and well coloured at the edges.

Arrange the rocket on a large plate or in a shallow bowl. Pile the warm roasted vegetables on top. Scatter over the {{feta}} of crumbled feta and the basil leaves if using. Drizzle with the lemon juice and 2 tablespoons of extra-virgin olive oil. Add {{black-pepper}} of black pepper. Do not add extra salt: the feta will season the whole salad.

items.symptom: Vegetables are pale and soft rather than coloured
items.cause: Crowded on the tray or oven not hot enough.
items.fix: Use a 200 C oven and give each piece space. Overcrowded vegetables steam in their own moisture instead of roasting. Split between two trays if needed.

items.cause: Feta plus seasoned vegetables can add up.
items.fix: Do not add extra salt. Rinse the feta before crumbling to reduce some of the brine salt.

content.text: This salad is a British take on Eastern Mediterranean mezze. Aubergine, pepper, courgette and feta all became supermarket staples in the 1990s. It works warm in winter or at room temperature in summer.
